column2: Your salary looks fine. So why did the bank say no? Usually, it's one number: your D S R.
Debt service ratio. Add up your monthly debts, then divide by your net income, after E P F and tax.
Illustration: five thousand net a month. Car loan, eight hundred. P T P T N, two hundred. The new home loan, two thousand.
That's three thousand in debts. Divide by five thousand: sixty percent of your income.
A credit card you pay in full may still count. Here, five hundred more: now seventy percent.
Each bank sets its own limit, and may also check what's left after your debts.
To bring it down, cancel cards you don't use, and clear small loans before you apply.
Cancel that card, clear the car loan, and the same home is forty-four percent.
Comment D S R, and we'll work out your number before you view.
